raw_html: [[Insightful Faith]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Insightful Faith]]:''' An item with this quality assists only wearers who have the ability to [[turn undead]]. Insightful Faith items provide [[Insight bonus|Insight Bonuses]] to the owner's effective level for the turning check by +2, their maximum Hit Dice turned by +2, and their total Hit Dice turned by +4.
